Any modern mobile, web, or backend technology is permitted! Popular stacks include Flutter, React Native, Swift, Kotlin for App Track; and Next.js, Svelte, Vue, React for Web Track. You can use backend runtimes like Node.js, Python FastAPI, Go, or Rust, along with cloud databases (Supabase, PostgreSQL, Firebase) and pre-trained AI APIs.
The builders retain 100% ownership of their ideas, code, designs, and intellectual property. Vistaara and its industry partners claim zero equity, zero IP rights, and zero exclusivity over anything you build during the hackathon.

In the Junior Division, standard kit components (like LEGO Spike, Tetrix, or off-the-shelf plates) are permitted. In Senior and Open divisions, custom fabricated chassis (aluminium CNC, 3D printed PETG/carbon nylon, steel armor) are strongly encouraged and score higher in design review judging.
Junior Division is limited to 12V DC (3S LiPo or NiMH). Senior Division permits up to 24V DC (6S LiPo). Open/Collegiate permits up to 48V DC. All robots must feature an externally accessible emergency master cut-off switch and power LED indicator.
During the initial 30 seconds of each match, pilots must place their wireless transmitters on the driver station console. Robots operate purely on onboard computer vision, LiDAR, or pre-programmed odometry. Scoring in this window carries bonus point multipliers.
Registered teams receive access to weekly virtual masterclasses with robotics alumni, CAD design critique sessions, firmware code libraries (ROS2 & OpenCV sample pipelines), and discounted component supply channels.

# Vistaara Hackathon — Updates & Features Walkthrough

## Latest Update: Ultra-Stylish VIP Builder Pass & Modal Fix

### 1. Root Cause Resolved: Why "Claim Builder Pass" Did Nothing
- The JavaScript function `openModal()` was toggling `modal.classList.add('active')`, but `styles.css` only possessed a selector for `.modal-backdrop.open { display: flex; }`.
- **Fix**: Added support for both `.modal-backdrop.open, .modal-backdrop.active { display: flex; }`, and updated `openModal` to reliably toggle both `.open` and `.active`.
- Also hooked up Escape key dismissal, backdrop click closing, and unified all 9 `.open-register-modal-btn` buttons across the site (hero terminal, header, mobile drawer, tracks, evaluator, and footer).

---

### 2. High-Tech Cyberpunk VIP Builder Pass Badge
Transformed the generic pass confirmation into an authentic **VIP Hacker / Builder Lanyard Credential Badge** with high-end tactile details:

- **Hardware Lanyard Mount**: Top center lanyard slot cutout with metallic clasp brackets.
- **Obsidian Cyber Shell**: Dark radial gradient with cyber circuit blueprint grid lines and glowing outer border.
- **Holographic Iridescent Foil Sheen**: Animated multi-spectrum iridescent shimmer overlay with smooth CSS keyframes.
- **Interactive 3D Perspective Tilt**: The badge responds in real time to cursor movements with realistic 3D perspective tilt (`rotateX`, `rotateY`).
- **Team Identity Hero Typography**: Large, glowing display typography for the team call-sign (`ORBIT BUILDERS`), accented by glowing neon capsule pills for Track and Theme.
- **Scannable Cyber QR Matrix & Laser Scan Bar**: Scannable QR code enclosed in cyan corner brackets (`⌜ ⌝ ⌞ ⌟`) with a sweeping neon cyan laser line (`@keyframes laserSweep`).
- **Authentic Linear Barcode Strip**: Real barcode lines with stencil code `*VST-2026-BUILDER-PASS*`.
- **Perforated Ticket Stub Notches**: Physical semicircle edge notches with dashed tear-off line.
- **Full Action Suite**:
  - **Download Official Pass (PNG)**: Exports a 1200x640 2X retina canvas badge with the active theme colors (`Blueprint`, `Emerald`, `Violet`, `Solar`, `Monochrome`).
  - **Copy Pass Serial**: One-click clipboard copy with animated visual feedback.
  - **Print Pass**: Dedicated `@media print` layout allowing builders to print a physical badge.
  - **Edit Details**: Seamlessly navigates back to Step 1.
